access_gate: The first real case of every configuration is a counted compatibility gate; any native parameter or access rejection stops the study without retry, settings change or route substitution.
done: All 72 once-only cases have truthful terminal records, blind source-based grades, a quality/latency report and a passing saved-evidence audit; a native compatibility or access blocker instead requires an honest attempted prefix, unrun suffix and unresolved-comparison report.
